title: GraphSmith Attestation (GSA) Bundle Manifest
description: Root manifest (attestation.json) of a GSA bundle: a signed, replayable, tamper-evident record of one AI-generated workflow run. DRAFT v0.1 — breaking changes possible until v1.0. This manifest indexes and hash-binds every component artifact; the manifest file itself is excluded from the artifacts map and bound via bundle_signature.manifest_sha256. Producer-agnostic: any agent/runtime may emit a conformant bundle; GraphSmith is the reference implementation. An attestation proves WHAT HAPPENED and that the record is UNALTERED — it does NOT assert the workflow is safe, correct, or compliant (evidence layer, not certification).

schema_version.description: GSA bundle schema version (draft). Bumped on any breaking change until v1.0.

bundle_id.description: Stable identifier for this attestation bundle.

created.description: UTC timestamp the bundle was sealed (ISO 8601).

producer.description: The implementation that produced this bundle. Any conformant producer is valid; not restricted to GraphSmith.

spec_version.description: GSA spec version this producer targeted.

mode.description: Operating mode this run executed under. 'deterministic' disables skill-generation, auto-promotion, remote registries, runtime graph modification, unbounded repair, and undeclared network. 'regulator' = deterministic + full adversarial battery + regulator-ready export.

profiles.description: Capability profiles this bundle attests, each independently verifiable. R=resumable, E=effect-reconciled, B=budget-enforced, T=trust-root-verified, G=gated-learning, Q=assurance-tested, A=attested, X=adversarially-tested. (Q/R/E/B/T/G/X are emitted by v0.2.0 verify.js --profiles; A is new in GSA.)

artifacts.description: Content-addressed index of the canonical component artifacts. Every value is an artifactRef; the verifier recomputes each sha256 against the file on disk.

graph_signature.description: Binds the compiled graph, its policy, and its skill set at sign time (pre-execution approval / non-repudiation).

skills.description: Provenance record for every skill used in the run.

capabilities.description: Declared capability grants and the requested-vs-granted result, per resource class. Enforces requested <= granted before execution.

result.description: 'violated' means at least one skill requested capability beyond its grant; such a run halts pre-execution and the bundle records the violation.

control_attestations.description: Explicit, verifiable predicates for the five enterprise controls. Each is independently checkable against the trace/policy; making them explicit is the point — a CTO verifies rather than trusts.

auto_skill_creation_disabled.description: True iff no autonomously-created skill executed in the same trust flow (kill switch active).

all_skills_signed_and_approved.description: True iff every skill in `skills` is signed, approval_status=approved, and un-revoked.

deterministic_mode.description: True iff mode=deterministic|regulator and the trace shows none of the disabled behaviors.

regulator_mode.description: True iff mode=regulator and a regulator_summary artifact is present.

adversarial_batteries_passed.description: True iff the release's standing attack batteries passed for this producer version (X profile).

adversarial.description: Results of the standing attack batteries for the producer version that emitted this bundle (X profile evidence).

families.description: Model families the battery held across (runtime cross-family diversity), when applicable.

redactions.description: Record of redactions applied before sealing (field path + reason). Redaction preserves the hash chain via documented placeholders.

bundle_signature.description: Signs the whole sealed bundle. manifest_sha256 binds this manifest (with the bundle_signature.value field excluded from the hash preimage). Keyless (transparency-log) signing is optional; local keypair signing is the default.

path.description: Bundle-relative path, forward slashes, Unicode NFC canonicalized.

approval_status.description: Only 'approved' skills may execute in a run whose control_attestations.all_skills_signed_and_approved is true.

capGrant.description: Requested and granted capability for one resource class; requested must be a subset of granted for a satisfied result.
